newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Ommeren takes stake in Norway's Iver.
newsitem.headline: Van Ommeren takes stake in Norway's Iver.

text.p: Dutch shipping and tank storage firm Koninklijke van Ommeren NV said on Tuesday it was acquiring a 40 percent stake in Norwegian shipping firm Iver.
It acquired the 40 percent stake for $11 million, it said.
Iver ships will become commercial manager for Van Ommeren's international shipping fleet from January 1997, it said in a statement.
Other shareholders of Iver ships are Vroon Group (40 pct), and the management.
After the deal, Iver's fleet will consist of 23 ships, including eight tankers that belong to Van Ommeren.
